Hi Noah,

Glad that cleared it up, and thanks for checking with us first. Good to hear you've answered Abel.

Thanks for getting the NerdQaxe++ sent back. Once it arrives at our warehouse, your BC04 goes out and the tracking comes to this email. I hope you enjoy it.

When you're ready to look at a Scrypt miner for Doge, just reply here and I'll check what's in stock at that point. One quick question so I can point you the right way: are you after a small home unit like your current ones, or something bigger?

Thanks for the kind words.

Sarah
